question: PM SVANidhi Scheme aims to empower ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Street Vendors.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM SVANidhi Scheme **is aimed at **empowering street vendors** in India.
 
• The scheme provides **financial assistance** to street vendors to resume their businesses that were affected during the **COVID-19 pandemic.**
 
• The scheme targets over** 50 lakh street vendors **in urban and rural areas of the country.
 
• The vendors can avail loans up to **Rs. 10,000 **which can be repaid in** monthly installments** within a year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **June 1st, 2023,** the **Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs** (MoHUA) released a** mobile app **for street vendors (SVs) featuring Prime Minister SVANidhi. 
 
• Street Vendors (SV) can use a mobile app to** apply for a loan **and a **letter of recommendation** (LoR) under the PM SVANidhi Scheme.
 
• Additionally, the SV has access to their** cashback history and loan application status.**
 
• According to the **Cabinet Committe e on Economic Affairs' **decision from **April 26,2022,** the target under the PM SVANidhi Scheme is set at **42 lakh, 12 lakh, and 3 lakh**, respectively, by the end of **2024.**
